evidence: Has the Descriptors label, heavily alters descriptor management and parsing in src/script/descriptor.*, and updates multiple src/wallet/ modules.
rationale: Refactoring descriptor parsing to preserve multipath representations in a single object fixes multipath string loss in getdescriptorinfo and enables #36443 and #36444. Per the PR description, multipath elements were previously lost after parsing, preventing the node from returning the original multipath string.
